amendments.summary: Estimation attempted (Task A5); no factor met the update rule (combined n>=8, CI excludes assumed, CI excludes 0). All assumed factors retained; priors not regenerated.

Resolution pass over the 25 unresolved S3 registry IDs (strong evidence only): 2 resolved (Asalanka -> 732c038e 'KIC Asalanka'; Arachchige -> c05f9d20 'SSD Arachchige', both initials_surname_unique with full-name + appearance-record evidence; see data/predictions/player_resolution_log.csv). 23 remain unresolved. Priors regenerated: external_pro 14 -> 16, debutant 28 -> 26; only the two resolved players' rows changed; player_history.csv unchanged; no constant changed. All 56 locked rows used pre-amendment priors and stay as locked.

after.selection_disclosure: Constants are the argmin of the restricted grid (K 20-32 x regression 0.25-0.40) evaluated on the S2 walk-forward -- selection on the reported test set (F1 finding).
after.standing_rule: Future parameter selection must be nested: select on earlier seasons only, never on the season reported as the evaluation.

amendments.summary: F1 audit (scripts/audit_elo_selection.py -> data/predictions/elo_selection_audit.json): Elo constants were selected on the S2 set also reported as the backtest. Bound: restricted-grid S2 surface range 0.0050 (outer full-grid range 0.0201). S1-only reselection picks K=28, worse on S2 by 0.00028 (within-0.002 branch). Regression 0.40 rests on the research prior (25-40%), not clean selection. No constant changed; S3 frozen log unaffected (parameters fixed before Match 1); contamination is in the historical S2 evaluation claim only. Standing rule added: nested selection (earlier seasons only).

after.statement: Ratings, priors and regenerated forecasts update after every match whose cricsheet data has been published and ingested.

measured_s2_lag_days.basis: cricsheet meta.created minus match date, NPL bundle, Season 2

amendments.summary: F3 correction: frozen section 3's 'update after every match' overstated the cadence; cricsheet publication lags matches (S2 measured median 8 days, range 0-14, via meta.created). Corrected statement in force; as-of sidecar + dashboard labelling added; no constant or protocol change; matchday locks unaffected (manual capture).

G1 (review S13): canonical stage names introduced because 'P1' named two information sets (pre-season expected-XI locks vs matchday confirmed-XI). Naming layer only: scoring groups by canonical horizon, dashboard displays canonical labels, locks keep writing the existing stored strings via the registry; no constant, rule or locked row changed.

after.supersession: ingested cricsheet record wins; provisional row ignored and reported superseded
after.disagreement: flagged as data-quality warning in predictions_status.json; never silently resolved, never blocking

amendments.summary: Provisional results policy (review S14; owner decision 2026-10-24, before Match 1): winner-only manual capture from official sources bridges the measured cricsheet lag (S2 median 8 days). Provisional matches move Elo with neutral MOV = 1.0 (no margin captured or estimated). Ratings-with-provisional are a pure function of (ingested matches, fixtures, provisional file). On cricsheet ingestion the provisional row is superseded (canonical wins); a winner disagreement is flagged as a data-quality warning, never silently resolved. Locks record ratings_basis / n_provisional_applied / data_as_of in features_json. No constant changed; all 56 locked rows predate any provisional data (basis canonical) and stay as locked; frozen-log scoring still uses cricsheet outcomes only.

checkpoint_rule: Refit only after S3 matches 10 and 20; promotion only if the refit beats the frozen champion on since-checkpoint frozen-log log-loss.
simulator_promotion_rule: Shadow until it beats the champion on the S3 frozen log (log-loss, paired-bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero).
